answer: Yarrow-atlas relic age-table bond: each newcomer registers one onyx relic in a yarrow plot, locks 70, pays 38. Auditors count its growth bands, seal them with a key-bound umber mark, and recompute age from the public atlas table; deviation over 3% or reused banding burns the bond. Fees run 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented-relic rings stand exposed. Honest agents pay 38 once, recover the bond.
